scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @acronote/api" "npm run dev -w @acronote/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @acronote/shared && npm run build -w @acronote/web && npm run build -w @acronote/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @acronote/shared && npm run typecheck -w @acronote/web && npm run typecheck -w @acronote/api
